title: Moneta and the Monuments: Coinage and Politics in Republican Rome
abstract: The mint of Republican Rome was located on the Capitol somewhere in the vicinity of the temple of Juno Moneta. This is one of the best known but perhaps worst attested pieces of topographical information concerning the Republican city of Rome.
